planets.name: HD 109833 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 109833 with a 9.19-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: HD 109833 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 109833. Its orbit and size follow Wood et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
